_status: ILLUSTRATIVE candidate for the DEMO run. Not the D4 crop set (D4 is open). Values are FAO-56 generic table values, not local calibration.

profile.name: Maize, field (grain)

kc_ini.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Cereals group Kc ini
kc_ini.region_relevance: Generic; Table 12 footnote 1: Kc ini depends on wetting interval and is better estimated with Fig. 29/30 or Annex 7 eq. 7-3
kc_ini.uncertainty: Kc ini may range 0.1-1.15 with wetting frequency (FAO-56 ch. 6)

kc_mid.region_relevance: Sub-humid reference climate (RHmin 45%, u2 2 m/s); adjusted to local climate with FAO-56 eq. 62 at run time

kc_end.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Maize, Field (grain)', Kc end 0.60-0.35, footnote 11
kc_end.region_relevance: 0.35 = harvest after complete field drying of the grain (assumed); 0.60 if harvested at high grain moisture

ini.reference: FAO-56 Table 11, Maize (grain), April planting, 'Idaho, USA' row (30/40/50/50)
ini.region_relevance: Nearest listed US semi-arid analogue; not specific to either candidate site
ini.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only, may vary substantially with region, climate and variety

max_root_depth_m.region_relevance: Table 22 footnote 1: larger values for modelling soil water stress or rainfed conditions
max_root_depth_m.uncertainty: 1.0-1.7 m; shallower where rooting is restricted

depletion_fraction_p.reference: FAO-56 Table 22 (for ETc about 5 mm/day); adjusted daily with p = p_table + 0.04(5 - ETc), limited to 0.1-0.8
depletion_fraction_p.uncertainty: FAO-56: reduce 5-10% on fine soils, increase 5-10% on coarse soils

profile.notes: Table 11 'Idaho, USA' row lists April planting. Printed total 170 days matches the stage sum.

max_height_m.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, maximum crop height h
